## Attendance

The Programme Board met in November 2025. Attendance was recorded as: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, M. Chen. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity and current outstanding work. There were 2632 captures during the reporting period. The backlog was 309, and 54 letters were recorded.

Members noted the importance of maintaining oversight of the backlog and ensuring that correspondence continues to be managed in a timely way. The position will remain under review through the programme’s routine performance monitoring.

## Items

The board considered INC-0274 Vendor API outage. The incident was noted, including its potential impact on service activity and operational continuity. Further information is required before the board can confirm that the matter has been fully resolved.

## Actions

The relevant lead is to provide an update on INC-0274 Vendor API outage and report back to the board. The update should cover the current position, any continuing effect on service delivery, and the steps being taken to prevent recurrence.

The chair will circulate the agreed actions and maintain oversight of follow-up work. Performance information on captures, the backlog and letters will continue to be reviewed at future meetings.
